scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Sep 4 Cienega Creek dark-sky session usable through the after-hours vehicle gate rather than the daytime public entrance.
Emerging Need: Site notices turn the future outing into one that needs a county gate roster entry before the trip begins.
Decision Context: The roster should not be supplied while the permit is pending; once opened, Miriam’s stored profile is needed for the exact member code and vehicle plate.
Consequence: If the export closes without her entry, the observing plan remains on the calendar but the required after-hours access prerequisite cannot be added.

parameter.title: Cienega Creek dark-sky observing night
parameter.description: Club casual observing session at the county-managed pullout; final gate logistics to follow from the site coordinator.
parameter.location: Cienega Creek Preserve east pullout, Pima County, AZ

parameter.subject: Cienega Creek night gate permit still pending
parameter.body: The Sep 4 observing night is still on, but the after-hours gate permit has not been approved yet. If Pima County approves it, they will require a vehicle roster before the ranger packet is exported. Please do not send plate details until the roster channel opens, because the county may still keep the normal public-access plan.

parameter.content: Cienega Creek permit approved. The after-hours gate roster is open in this thread until 2026-09-02T21:00:00-07:00. Each line must use attendee name, Sonoran Nightwatchers member code, and exact vehicle plate; the county export tonight will not accept on-site additions.

parameter.subject: Cienega roster preview before 9 PM export
parameter.body: Roster preview generated at 8:25 PM. Entries missing either member code or exact plate will be omitted from the county gate packet. No completed row is currently listed for Miriam Vale Ashcroft, and the export cutoff remains 9:00 PM tonight.

parameter.subject: Cienega Creek Sep 4 after-hours gate packet exported
parameter.body: The Sep 4 after-hours gate packet has been exported to the ranger station. Only the rostered vehicles in the attached export will be admitted through the night gate; late additions must use the public daytime entrance process and cannot be added to this packet.
